newsitem.title: USA: Sovereign sees Q1 oper shr $0.25 vs $0.22.
newsitem.headline: Sovereign sees Q1 oper shr $0.25 vs $0.22.

text.p: Sovereign Bancorp Inc on Thursday said it sees first quarter operating income at $19.9 million or $0.25 per share, before one-time acquisition charges, versus $0.22 per share a year ago.
The company said these numbers are consistent with analyst estimates.
Sovereign said first quarter results after a one-time charge of about $10.7 million, were $9.2 million, or $0.12.
The charges relate to Sovereign's first quarter acquisition of First State Financial, the company said.
During the first quarter of 1997, Sovereign completed its acquisition of First State Financial Services.
